units.source_text: 左大臣家知道源氏公子即将返邸，早有准备。

en.t: The household of the Minister of the Left knew that Prince Genji would soon return to the residence and had made preparations in advance.

units.source_text: 源氏公子久不到此，但见洞房清宫，布置得犹如玉楼金屋，万般用品，无不齐备。

en.t: Prince Genji had not come there for a long time, but he found the inner chambers and elegant rooms arranged like a palace of jade and gold, with every possible article fully prepared.

units.source_text: 但葵姬照例躲避，并不立刻出来迎接。

en.t: Lady Aoi, however, avoided him as usual and did not come out at once to receive him.

units.source_text: 经左大臣百般劝诱，好容易出来相见。

en.t: Only after the Minister of the Left urged and coaxed her in every way did she finally come out to meet him.

units.source_text: 然而只是正襟危坐，身体一动也不动。

en.t: Yet she merely sat upright with formal composure and did not move her body at all.

units.source_text: 端正严肃，犹如故事画中的美女。

en.t: She was proper and solemn, like a beautiful woman in an old illustrated tale.

units.source_text: 公子想道：“我想罄谈胸中观感，或叙述山中见闻，但愿有人答应，共同欣赏才好。

en.t: The prince thought, "I would like to pour out all that is in my heart, or tell of what I saw and heard in the mountains, and it would be good if someone would answer and share the feeling with me.

units.source_text: 可是这个人不肯开诚解怀，一味疏远冷淡。

en.t: But this woman will not open her heart honestly and remains distant and cold in every way.

units.source_text: 相处年月越久，彼此隔阂越深，真教人好生苦闷！”

en.t: The longer we spend together, the deeper the barrier between us becomes; it is truly distressing!"

units.source_text: 便开言道：“我希望看到你偶尔也能有家常夫妇亲睦之相，至今未能如愿。

en.t: Then he began to speak: "I have hoped to see you, at least now and then, show the warmth of an ordinary affectionate married couple, but even now my wish has not been fulfilled.

units.source_text: 我近日患病，痛苦难堪。

en.t: Recently I have been ill and have suffered unbearably.

units.source_text: 你对我绝不理睬，向来如此，原不足怪，但心中不免怨恨。”

en.t: You pay no attention to me at all, and since that has always been your way, it is hardly surprising, yet I cannot help feeling resentment in my heart."

units.source_text: 葵姬过了一会才答道：“你也知道不理睬是痛苦的么？”

en.t: After a while Lady Aoi answered, "So you too know that being ignored is painful?"

units.source_text: 说着，向他流目斜睇，眼色中含有无限娇羞，颜面上显出高贵之美。

en.t: As she said this, she cast him a sidelong glance; her eyes held endless shy charm, and her face showed a noble beauty.

units.source_text: 公子说：“你难得说话，一开口就教人吃惊。

en.t: The prince said, "You speak so rarely, yet when you open your mouth you startle a person at once.

units.source_text: ‘不理睬是痛苦的’，是情妇说的话，我们正式夫妻是不该说的。

en.t: Words like 'being ignored is painful' are what a mistress would say; we are formally married, and such words are not fitting for us.

units.source_text: 你一向对我态度冷淡，我总希望你回心转意，曾经用尽种种方法。

en.t: You have always been cold toward me, and I have always hoped you would change your heart, trying every sort of means.

units.source_text: 可是你越来越嫌恶我了。

en.t: But you have come to dislike me more and more.

units.source_text: 罢了罢了，只要我不死，且耐性等候吧。”

en.t: Enough, enough; as long as I do not die, I suppose I shall wait patiently for now."

units.source_text: 说罢，便走进寝室去了。

en.t: Having said this, he went into the bedchamber.

units.source_text: 但葵姬并不立刻进去。

en.t: But Lady Aoi did not go in immediately.

units.source_text: 公子已经倦于谈话，叹息数声，便解衣就寝。

en.t: The prince was already weary of talking, and after several sighs he loosened his robes and lay down to sleep.

units.source_text: 心绪不快，不欲再与葵姬交语，便装作想睡的样子，却在心中寻思世间种种事情。

en.t: Unhappy in spirit and unwilling to exchange any more words with Lady Aoi, he pretended that he wanted to sleep, while inwardly pondering all kinds of things in the world.
